name: Find Duplicate Files
description: Finds duplicate files by comparing file sizes and MD5 hashes
syntax: Get-ChildItem -Path {path} -Recurse -File | Group-Object -Property Length | Where-Object {$_.Count -gt 1} | ForEach-Object {$_.Group | ForEach-Object {$_ | Add-Member -NotePropertyName Hash -NotePropertyValue (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm MD5).Hash -PassThru}} | Group-Object -Property Hash | Where-Object {$_.Count -gt 1} | ForEach-Object {$_.Group | Select-Object FullName, Length, Hash}
